states.swap_first: swap Cirsium_kujuense with the challenged clade's parent-side sibling; the local alternative contains Cirsium_nipponicum_var_incomptum + Cirsium_suffultum
states.swap_second: swap Cirsium_nipponicum_var_incomptum with the challenged clade's parent-side sibling; the local alternative contains Cirsium_kujuense + Cirsium_suffultum

states.swap_first: swap Cirsium_maritimum with the challenged clade's parent-side sibling; the local alternative adds the split Cirsium_alpicola + Cirsium_gyojanum + Cirsium_nippoense + Cirsium_yezoense
states.swap_second: swap Cirsium_nippoense with the challenged clade's parent-side sibling; the local alternative adds the split Cirsium_alpicola + Cirsium_gyojanum + Cirsium_maritimum + Cirsium_yezoense

candidate_contract.design: full factorial of primary plus both NNI alternatives at each of two preregistered challenged edges

au_test.method: IQ-TREE candidate-tree topology test with 10000 RELL replicates and approximately unbiased test
au_test.command_contract: iqtree3 -s CONCAT -te PRIMARY_TREE -m TIM3+F+R3 -st DNA -z CANDIDATE_TREES -zb 10000 -au -seed 20260822 --prefix au -T AUTO
au_test.interpretation: p-AU < 0.05 rejects a candidate topology under the fixed comparison. Non-rejection is not evidence that a topology is uniquely true.

decision_policy.primary_only_nonrejected: the two local NNI alternatives are not retained as supported alternatives under this concatenated-alignment topology test
decision_policy.one_or_more_alternatives_nonrejected: retain the corresponding topology alternatives explicitly in downstream topology sensitivity
decision_policy.primary_rejected: the frozen primary tree remains an audit reference but cannot be treated as the uniquely adequate topology

promotion_boundary.claim_limit: This gate tests only the preregistered nine local topologies around the two site-challenged branches on the immutable 153-locus concatenated alignment. It does not search arbitrary topologies, delete loci, or permit colour-rate fitting.
